entries.title: Forward price from carrying costs
entries.description: Relates the forward price to the cash price, financing costs and benefits of holding the asset.

entries.title: Annual financing cost
entries.description: Computes the one-year interest cost of borrowing 100,000 at an annual rate of 8 percent.

entries.title: Effect of changing interest rates on option values.
entries.description: Rows are option types and settlement styles; columns are rises or falls in domestic and foreign interest rates, giving the effect on option values.

entries.title: Effect of changing dividends on stock option values.
entries.description: Rows are stock option calls and puts; columns are a dividend being raised or cut, giving the effect on option values.

entries.title: Likelihood of the D-vine copula
entries.description: The likelihood of the D-vine copula is the product over observations, tree levels and pairs of the pair copula densities evaluated at the conditional distribution functions.

entries.title: Likelihood of a C-vine copula
entries.description: The likelihood of a C-vine copula is the product over observations, tree levels and pairs of the pair copula densities evaluated at the conditional distribution functions.

entries.title: Profit profiles of three spreads
entries.description: Compares how the theoretical profit or loss of three spreads changes with the underlying price.

entries.title: Dividend sensitivity.
entries.description: Compares the theoretical profit or loss of four spreads as the expected quarterly dividend changes.

entries.title: Gamma-to-theta ratio
entries.description: Expresses the chapter’s reward-to-risk comparison for an option position using gamma and theta.

entries.title: Spread efficiency comparison
entries.description: Compares gamma-to-theta ratios and resulting efficiencies for the three spreads.

entries.title: FTSE 100 volatility surface. March 16. 2012.
entries.description: Shows how FTSE 100 implied volatility varies with exercise price and months to expiration on the stated date.
